actual_new_source_validation.privacy: Whitelisted facts and hashes only; public source paths are repository-relative. No host paths/process/job/session/run identifiers or full commands.

package.scope: Tracked Python/static package files in wheel/sdist only. Native binaries/config remain workspace resources.

previous_evidence.scope: Existing ROS-grasp/native/UI and synchronized-replay implementations and their previous actual proof remain unchanged. These earlier runs were not re-executed or aggregated as the new relative-reservation checks.

limits: The original exception identifies remaining estimated future-start lead at most 0.1 seconds; the exact original failure clock and stage costs were not recorded. It does not prove the absolute scheduled time had already passed at the exception.
The original saved admission checkpoint predates observed-start assignment. Missing observed-start details in that file do not mean its check was not reached.
Original CI145 chose a different relative curve than CI146. Its success is a separate observation, not a retry of the failed path or a performance comparison.
The original unchanged curve was re-evaluated offline with zero ROS goals. This is not an actual replay of the original dispatch or a reconstruction of its wall delay.

The 2.25-second injected preparation check is deterministic regression evidence. New actual stage durations and remaining margins are individual diagnostics, not a speedup, reliability rate, or original CI146 timing.

Planning 10 mm and observed-start 1 mm self-clearance thresholds are sampled experimental settings. They do not certify continuous-time clearance, physical hardware safety, exact FCL shape behavior, or unknown tracking errors.
Intentional collision comparison is a distinct negative control with its existing contact/cancel behavior. It is not counted as zero-contact safe execution.
Latest-head remote CI, protected merge, main followup and publication are recorded separately from these frozen local results.
publication_scope: Reduced synthetic-case facts, repository-relative source paths and reviewed hashes; no raw logs, full curves, host paths, process/session/job identifiers, CAD or model assets.

publication_checks.scope: Final local publication checks after the concrete evidence file was written. Latest remote checks/merges/publication remain separate.
